title: Kallaway stage plan
description: Per-reel graphic choices for a Kallaway talking-head edit. Use stages to art-direct the automatic split slots. The closing split of that cut stays the lead-magnet document fan and is not listed there. Use beats when the reel needs its own layout, including a mid-roll Comment header and no end card. Without a plan, the editor rotates motifs from a seed of the video path and does not repeat a motif on back-to-back split shots.

stages.description: One object per split shot you want to art-direct, in spoken order. Omit a shot and the seeded rotation fills it. A list of motif names is also accepted by the planner and means the same thing as stages with only a motif, applied in slot order. Do not combine stages with beats.

beats.description: Authored camera and graphic beats. The first beat is a split. Each later beat starts at its spoken phrase. A beat longer than 5.4s is cut on a word, and the overflow becomes a full-screen or punch-in so a motif is not repeated. The last beat ends on the last word. There is no automatic end card.

spoken.description: Word where the bed cuts to silence.

hit.description: Play a bass hit when the bed returns. Defaults to true.

chips.description: Persistent corner labels. from is a spoken phrase where the chip appears. after is a beat phrase, and the chip starts when that beat ends.

keep_case.description: Tokens that keep this spelling on screen, such as PAID, AI, and ADA. Other captions stay lowercase.

emphasis.description: Caption color by word. An explicit color wins over the automatic amber list (no, not, never).

bed_bpm.description: Lo-fi bed tempo for this reel. The default bed stays 82 when this is omitted.

punch_scale.description: Scale for punch-in shots in this plan. The theme default stays 1.16.

object_position.description: CSS object-position for the face, such as 50% 28%.

spoken.description: A short phrase copied from stage_slots.spoken for the split shot this graphic illustrates. When any stage sets spoken or word_range, every stage must set one of them.

word_range.description: [start, end) indexes into the word list this timeline was planned against. The start word must fall inside a split shot.

why.description: Author note for the next editor. Not drawn on screen.

media.description: Local image or video for phone_frame, broll_card, or highlight_box. Absolute path, or a path relative to the plan file's directory when the runner loads it next to the timeline.

text.description: Sentence typed on screen for typing_ui.

heights.description: Bar heights as percentages for bar_chart.

hold.description: Keep the numbered-list box on active instead of stepping through every row.

active.description: Zero-based row the numbered-list box holds.

reveal.description: Bar-chart entrance. slice rises the bars together.

duration.description: Seconds the pan takes. It holds after that so a later circle can land on the framed detail.

scroll.description: Pan a phone screenshot. 0 is the top of the image and 1 is the bottom.

callout.description: Circle on a phone or card. spoken is the word it lands on. x, y, w, h are fractions of the frame.

highlight.description: Popped line on a phone screenshot. spoken is the word it lands on. label is the on-screen text.

pages.description: doc_fan pages as [kicker, title] pairs. Automatic cuts fill these from the theme. An authored beat can set them on a mid-reel fan.

spoken.description: Word the circle or highlight lands on.

disclaimer.description: Small notice held for the whole beat, including full-screen pieces.
